values.about.seo.title: About Us
values.about.seo.description: Project Starburst provides food, personal hygiene, and essential items to neighbors in Mecosta and Osceola counties with dignity, respect, and compassion.
values.about.about-hero.project-starburst-is-de: Project Starburst is dedicated to providing food, hygiene products, and essential services to residents of Mecosta and Osceola counties. By fostering a sense of community, we ensure that individuals and families facing hardship receive the support they need with dignity and respect.
values.about.what-we-do.we-provide-monthly-groc: We provide monthly groceries based on family size and dietary restrictions.
values.about.what-we-do.1-fill-out-a-brief-inta: 1️⃣ Fill out a brief intake form to assess your needs.
values.about.what-we-do.3-pick-up-your-grocerie: 3️⃣ Pick up your groceries and receive additional support if needed.

values.about.individual-case-management.hygiene: ✅ Hygiene Items Assistance – donated Bombas socks.
values.about.making-a-difference-in-our-communi: Making a Difference in Our Community

values.help.seo.title: Get Help
values.help.seo.description: Find food and basic-needs support in Mecosta and Osceola counties. See Project Starburst’s Big Rapids pantry hours, location, and in-person grocery process.

values.help.hero.here-for-our-neighbors-with-di: Here for our neighbors. With dignity, respect, and compassion.
values.help.action-section-action-container.foo: Food on the table. Everyday necessities. A place to turn when you need support.
values.help.action-section-action-container.gro: Groceries for families and individuals, packed for your household size and dietary needs after a brief intake form.
values.help.action-section-action-container.per: Personal hygiene items, donated Bombas socks, and a diaper bank for qualified children. Please call ahead about the diaper bank.
values.help.action-section-action-container.ind: Individual case management and referrals to local agencies, including Mid Michigan Community Action Center, Michigan Works, and Michigan Department of Health & Human Services.

values.help.how-it-works.visit-the-pantry-and-f: Visit the pantry and fill out an intake form. Our team enters your information into our computer system so we can meet your needs.
values.help.how-it-works.once-you-re-registered: Once you’re registered, volunteers pack your groceries based on your family size and dietary needs.
values.help.how-it-works.your-groceries-are-pla: Your groceries are placed in a wagon to take to your vehicle. After unloading, please return the wagon inside for the next family.
values.help.not-sure-where-to-start.call-during: Call during pantry hours or send us an email. We’re here to answer your questions.

values.souper.content.three-girls-bakery-106-n-: Three Girls Bakery, 106 N Michigan Ave, Big Rapids, MI 49307, USA
values.souper.content.this-event-is-a-fundraise: This event is a fundraiser for Project Starburst. Your ticket includes a bowl of soup from the selection you choose at the event. Proceeds from ticket sales support Project Starburst and help further their mission of serving our community.
values.souper.about-the-souper-supper.the-8th-a: The 8th Annual Souper Supper – Warm Bowls, Warm Hearts is Project Starburst’s signature community fundraiser, bringing neighbors together over a warm meal to support individuals and families facing food insecurity and other essential needs. The event takes place on Wednesday, March 25, 2026, from 11:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. at Three Girls Bakery, 106 N. Michigan Avenue in downtown Big Rapids. All proceeds directly benefit Project Starburst programs serving Mecosta and Osceola counties. Tickets can be purchased online or in person starting February 9, 2026, at Three Girls Bakery (106 N. Michigan Ave.) or Project Starburst (120 S. State Street, Big Rapids).

values.stories.ruth.name: Ruth
values.stories.ruth.quote: I had to use a food pantry for the first time ever. The people are friendly, helpful, and non judgemental. Thank you for your service to the community for those in need. I am truly grateful! Thank you!
values.stories.kelly-birth-certificate.name: Kelly
values.stories.kelly-birth-certificate.quote: They were very helpful with my birth certificate it wasn't no waiting fill out the form an that was it very nice place
values.stories.dawn.name: Dawn
values.stories.dawn.quote: They were very nice to me, not inundating me with paperwork. Filled up a wagon full of food , including can goods, dairy & meat. They always have clothing to look through to where u inevitably find something you like!
values.stories.kelly-food.name: Kelly
values.stories.kelly-food.quote: These people are friendly and helpful. Thanks a million what you do! My family wouldn't have food if it wasn't for you.
values.stories.ivory.name: Ivory
values.stories.ivory.quote: Always a good experience honestly. Most of the people are volunteering.
values.stories.karla.name: Karla
values.stories.karla.quote: Took my granddaughter there to get diapers for her baby. They are very helpful.
values.stories.renee.name: Renee
values.stories.renee.quote: Project Starburst has saved me more times than I can count. God bless them,the staff and everything they do to help the community 🙏 ❤
